scheme.description: Signature scheme tag of the client key (ed25519, ecdsa-p256).

public_key.description: Client public key, hex-encoded; its encoding is fixed by the scheme.

grant.description: Opaque scope grant, presented to the deployment's grant verifier; it binds the session, principal, scope, lineage and client key. Not covered by the client signature. The reference verifier takes a hex Ed25519 operator signature over the domain tag bc/v1/grant and those fields.

signature.description: Signature by the attaching key over canonical JSON of ["bc/v1/attach", bridge_id, session_id, principal, scope, lineage, key_id, scheme, public_key].
